communication_goal: 说明配置障碍并请求指导。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Make named learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI marks allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure coworkers at a desk, developer seated left and teammate standing right leaning toward a desktop monitor. A separate physical keyboard with clear key grid is fully visible horizontally on the desk foreground center. Teammate points near the keyboard without obscuring it while developer asks with open palm. Screen contains abstract rectangles without letters. Entire keyboard and both hands visible.

coverage_review.scope: W004 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

inversion.note: 原图保留；本卡发布用图为原图精确 RGB 反色（黑底白线）。

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/W004.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 通过：开发者就本地配置向同事求助，屏幕是无文字示意，前景完整独立键盘清楚可见；软件依赖与安装由对白说明。
